option.name: INTERPRETER_OPTIONS
option.value: -c "import subprocess, sys; steps = [('Ruff Lint', [sys.executable, '-m', 'ruff', 'check', '.']), ('Ruff Format', [sys.executable, '-m', 'ruff', 'format', '--check', '.']), ('Mypy Type Check', [sys.executable, '-m', 'mypy', 'src', 'tests', 'scripts']), ('Pytest Suite', [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest'])]; [print(f'\n=== {name} ===', flush=True) or (sys.exit(r.returncode) if (r := subprocess.run(cmd)).returncode != 0 else None) for name, cmd in steps]; print('\nAll Quality Gate checks passed!')"
